units.source_text: 于是，他开始对沙地产生兴趣。

en.t: And so, he began to take an interest in sandy ground.
And before long, it began to produce results.

units.source_text: —天，在家里附近的河滩上，他发现了一条身体小小的、浅桃红色的虫，

en.t: One day, on the riverbank near his home, he found a small, pale pink insect,

units.source_text: 与鞘翅目的斑蝥（Cicindela Japana Motschulsky）十分相像。

en.t: which closely resembled the tiger beetle of the order Coleoptera (Cicindela Japana Motschulsky).

units.source_text: 当然，众所周知，斑蝥背上的颜色和花样常常翻新。

en.t: Of course, as everyone knows, the colors and patterns on a tiger beetle's back often change.

units.source_text: 可要是说到前腿的形状，那可就另当别论了。

en.t: But when it comes to the shape of the forelegs, that is another matter entirely.

units.source_text: 鞘翅目昆虫的前腿，是区分类别的重要基准，

en.t: The forelegs of coleopteran insects are an important standard for distinguishing types,

units.source_text: 前腿的形状不同，就意味着种类不同。

en.t: and a difference in the shape of the forelegs means a difference in species.

units.source_text: 他所见到的那条虫，前腿的第二关节有个明显的特征。

en.t: The insect he had seen had a distinct feature on the second joint of its forelegs.
